items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: McCoskey played saxophone. You know McCoskey played the solo band.

ctx.x: Played in, huh? But he's still mainly alto. This is fine. I could play right in the place. You just got all this, man. You know, the old time guy.

You know, the fella, the star, probably never gave it a thought. Musician. He wasn't good. If he hit, it's alright. I mean, I know he played good. He was a, I would say, cause he was a nice little guy. He was a handsome guy. Could sing good. He played banjo. And his name was Johnny Toast. He played at the old ringside, way before Sharky played at the ringside, with the Midnight Serenaders. They had a guy named Tom Heron playing drums, you know. And he played there. And McCoskey played saxophone. You know McCoskey…
How many drumming to you? McCoskey.
